info.name: D Ceylon Backend API
info.description: Complete D Ceylon v1 API collection generated from packages/sdk/openapi/v1.json. Request bodies contain realistic Sri Lankan travel examples. Run the testing-token requests only against APP_ENVIRONMENT=Testing; otherwise, paste NestJS-issued bearer tokens into the matching environment variables. Requests capture created IDs and concurrency tokens. Accept, decline, revise, withdraw, cancellation, and delete requests are alternative/destructive transitions and should be run deliberately rather than by running the entire collection in one pass.

item.name: 00 - Testing authentication
item.description: Available only when the backend runs with APP_ENVIRONMENT=Testing. Otherwise, obtain application tokens from the NestJS authentication endpoints and paste them into the environment.
